title: Lower ME: Front Squat + Speed
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd · B-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Front Squat 3 @ RPE 8, fast up → Box Jump 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Concentric wk 1: normal lowering, then drive up as FAST as possible · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · elbows high
note: Concentric phase: no tempo. Control the way down, then move the bar as fast as you can.
